display_information.name: ShipGremlins
display_information.description: PM Gremlins find the gaps. Coding Gremlins fix them. Evidence, blockers, and review-ready work delivered to Slack.
display_information.long_description: Your app's tiny, tireless crew. PM Gremlins explore your app in a real browser and report findings. Coding Gremlins pick up approved tickets, run checks, and prepare draft pull requests. Connect your self-hosted ShipGremlins instance, choose a channel, and receive clear updates when work starts, needs attention, or is ready for review. The app only posts updates to the channel you choose. It does not read your messages. A draft pull request is not Done: tickets remain open until the production merge is verified.
